config.selection: Smallest eligible diagnostic WSI per patient, then ascending size; convenience sample for bounded technical feasibility, not representative sampling
config.emt_score: mean(log2(TPM+1), mesenchymal genes) - mean(log2(TPM+1), epithelial genes)
config.secondary_analysis: Exploratory bulk RNA composite prediction using site-held-out Ridge regression versus training-mean baseline
config.stage_analysis_gate: At least 10 patients in each broad stage I, II, III and IV; otherwise no four-stage model
config.expert_pathology_review: Not performed; mandatory before tumor-specific or clinical claims
